findings.highlight: Using a small connection like a blood vessel
findings.evidenceJa: 血液が流れるように、繋がった細い回路から
findings.governingReading: through a connected, slender circuit, as blood flows through a vessel
findings.explanation: The magical circuit carrying inaccessible memory becomes a generic small connection compared to a blood vessel.

findings.highlight: I’m sure his life was a happy one.
findings.evidenceJa: 控えめに言っても、それは幸福よりだったろう
findings.governingReading: Even put conservatively, the result must have leaned toward happiness.
findings.explanation: A qualified assessment of the results of his rescues becomes certainty that his own life was happy.
The Buddhist-inflected scope of beings to be saved is narrowed to people.

findings.governingReading: a narrow, cramped set of values
findings.explanation: A criticism of constricted perspective becomes an undefined “extreme value.”

findings.highlight: He had friends and a lover.
findings.evidenceJa: 仲間らしきモノもいたし、恋人らしきモノもいた
findings.governingReading: He had things resembling companions and something resembling a lover.
findings.explanation: The dream’s deliberately distanced uncertainty is converted into definite relationships.

findings.highlight: he lets go of the sword
findings.evidenceJa: 崩れ落ちるように、剣から手を放した
findings.governingReading: he releases his hand from the sword as though collapsing
findings.explanation: The physical collapse accompanying the final release disappears.
